7815.title: Repeated font completion events trigger redundant terminal measurements
7815.rootCauseOneLine: The font-loading observer remeasures on every completion event, including duplicate notifications for an already processed face.

prReviews.verdict: Static direction matches the verified mechanism; not executed
prReviews.topFinding: Existing open PR deduplicates font-face events; WebKit paint and cursor behavior remain unverified.

7815.proposedFix: Deduplicate completed font faces before measuring while preserving initial ready, late new faces, and disposal behavior.
7815.caveats: Two clean helper reproductions confirm 20 redundant option writes for ten duplicate events; WebKit timing and blank frames were not verified because the browser backend was unavailable. Existing PR #7816 prevents a duplicate fix PR. Reproduction test is inline in the HTML, per reports repository policy.
